ASX closed volatile week with modest gains as oil prices and bond yields eased; big four banks advanced
Recession odds for 2027 rising; 'four horsemen' narrative signals growing macro fragility
Iron ore prices under pressure; Japan diverting Australian LNG to domestic use, squeezing East Coast supply
Bendigo Bank (BEN.AX) announces Adelaide-based job cuts; Qantas (QAN.AX) ground staff strike looms
Forrestania and Aurum (AUG.AX) gold discoveries boost junior miners; Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre signals tech capex
Coles (COL.AX) retains elevated milk prices despite removing farmer support, fuelling CPI concerns
Housing affordability at record lows; ACCC moves against real estate agent monopoly; tenants see rent relief

sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure ('roaches seethe'); gold discoveries at Forrestania and Aurum lift junior miners; LNG supply diverted to Japan
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin headwinds from soft iron ore; gold juniors (AUG.AX, FOR.AX) attract speculative flows; Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) benefit from tighter LNG supply

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced on easing yields; Bendigo Bank cuts jobs; state interest costs soaring; IMF flags fiscal tightening
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX supported by NIM expansion if RBA hikes; BEN.AX under pressure from cost-cutting; sovereign debt stress weighs on state-linked equities

sectors.trend: Oil prices eased but Hormuz crisis keeps floor elevated; petrol price shock hits consumers; Victoria retreats from renewable transmission
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, AWE.AX benefit from higher oil floor; consumer energy costs pressure WES.AX, SGP.AX; renewable capex delay hurts CSP.AX, IAG.AX

sectors.trend: Coles retains milk price premium; Qantas strike risk; petrol shock squeezes household budgets
sectors.implications: WES.AX, COL.AX face margin pressure from input costs; QAN.AX exposed to industrial action; defensive rotation into staples likely

sectors.trend: Housing 'absurdly unaffordable'; ACCC targets agent monopoly; tenants see rent relief
sectors.implications: OGP.AX, VMC.AX, DGL.AX face regulatory and affordability headwinds; residential REITs pressured by policy intervention

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal; AI job-displacement narrative; ASX small-cap tech (CurveBeam, Arrow) outperform
sectors.implications: Datacentre capex benefits infrastructure and power names; small-cap tech (CRB.AX, ARW.AX) see momentum; CSL.AX (health-tech) remains defensive anchor

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot risk: blunt warning + IMF pressure suggests rate hike probability rising, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, gold strong, LNG tight – diversification within materials critical
Fiscal stress: state interest costs soaring, IMF urging cuts, potential NT funding standoff
Consumer squeeze: petrol shock + milk prices + housing unaffordability eroding disposable income
Industrial risk: Qantas strike, Bendigo cuts signal labour-market fragility
Geopolitical oil floor: Hormuz/Saudi export disruption supports energy pricing

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in REITs and growth equities; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement language
Overweight defensive staples (WES.AX, SGP.AX), healthcare (CSL.AX); underweight cyclicals (FMG.AX, QAN.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East / Hormuz oil supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, AWE.AX; monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor transport and tourism-linked names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fiscal / sovereign stress (state interest costs, NT funding)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor state bond spreads; favour federal-linked infrastructure plays
Favour value retail; avoid discretionary consumer exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold-exposed miners on discovery catalysts and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania PFS and Aurum high-grade intercepts signal sector upside; recession fears support gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add to big four banks on NIM expansion from potential RBA hike
opportunities.rationale: Banks advanced on easing yields; further hike widens spreads; strong capital positions

opportunities.recommendation: Position in LNG/energy producers on tight supply and Hormuz-driven oil floor
opportunities.rationale: Japan diverting gas, StanChart sees higher oil floor; structural supply tightness

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap tech on datacentre capex wave
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn QLD deal signals sustained AI infrastructure spend; CurveBeam, Arrow outperforming

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing unaffordability, ACCC regulatory threat, rent relief policy risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight iron ore majors on price softness
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'roaches seethe' signals demand weakness; China property overhang persists

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas and transport names ahead of strike
defensive_moves.rationale: Industrial action risk over Joyce-era agreements; operational disruption

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as RBA decision approaches
defensive_moves.rationale: Hawkish RBA + IMF pressure create volatility; preserve capital for post-decision entry

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly lower into RBA decision. Volatility elevated on oil/Hormuz headlines and rate uncertainty. Banks and energy provide relative strength; REITs and cyclicals lag. Expect 1–2% index swings around the rate announcement.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds, consumer squeeze, and fiscal tightening cap upside. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer relative resilience. A soft-landing scenario keeps BHP/CBA relevant but at lower multiples. Structural LNG tightness and AI capex are positive secular themes.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (imminent)
IMF Article IV / fiscal policy response
Iron ore contract pricing and China property data
Hormuz / Middle East oil supply developments
